title: Sum from 1 to N
problem_statement: Students must calculate the sum of all integers from 1 through N.
output_format: Print the sum from 1 through N.

bugs.description: sum starts at 1 instead of 0.
bugs.why_wrong: The accumulator already contains an extra 1 before the loop adds the numbers.

title: Find the Largest Mark
problem_statement: Given N marks, print the largest mark.
input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers.

bugs.description: max starts at 0 instead of the first array element.
bugs.why_wrong: If every input value is negative, 0 is not an input value and is incorrectly reported as the maximum.

title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
problem_statement: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using F = C * 9 / 5 + 32.
input_format: Input contains one real number C.
output_format: Print Fahrenheit with exactly 2 decimal places.

bugs.description: The constant 30.0 is added instead of 32.0.
bugs.why_wrong: The Fahrenheit conversion formula requires an offset of 32 degrees.

title: Count Even Numbers
problem_statement: Given N integers, count how many are even.
input_format: First line contains N. Second line contains N integers.
output_format: Print the number of even integers.

bugs.description: The condition checks for remainder 1 instead of remainder 0.
bugs.why_wrong: An integer is even when its remainder after division by 2 is 0.

title: Factorial of N
problem_statement: Calculate N! for a non-negative integer N.

bugs.description: The loop stops when i reaches n because it uses i < n.
bugs.why_wrong: N! must include multiplication by N, so the loop must continue through i == n.

title: First Occurrence Search
problem_statement: Find the index of the first occurrence of a target in an array. If it is absent, print -1.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N integers. Third line: target.
output_format: Print the zero-based index of the first occurrence, or -1.

bugs.description: The loop uses i < n - 1, so it never checks index n - 1.
bugs.why_wrong: The last array element is a valid position and must also be checked.

title: Reverse a Number
problem_statement: Reverse the digits of a positive integer. For example, 1234 becomes 4321.
input_format: Input contains one positive integer N.

bugs.description: The new digit is added directly to rev instead of shifting existing digits left by one decimal place.
bugs.why_wrong: To append a digit, the existing reversed number must be multiplied by 10 before adding the digit.

title: Row Sums of a Matrix
problem_statement: Given an N x M matrix, print the sum of each row in order.
input_format: First line contains N and M. Next N lines contain M integers.
output_format: Print N row sums separated by spaces.

bugs.description: sum is initialized only once before all rows are processed.
bugs.why_wrong: Each row needs a fresh sum; otherwise later rows include values from earlier rows.

title: Student Result Calculator
problem_statement: Calculate the result of a student from five subject marks. The total is the sum of all five marks. Average is total/5. Grade is A for average >= 90, B for >= 75, C for >= 60, D for >= 40, otherwise F.
input_format: Input contains five integer marks on one line or multiple lines.
output_format: Print total, average with 2 decimals, and grade on separate lines.

bugs.description: total starts at 1 instead of 0.
bugs.why_wrong: The total must begin at zero before marks are added.

bugs.description: The loop reads only four marks instead of five.
bugs.why_wrong: All five subject marks are part of the result.

bugs.description: The average is divided by 4 instead of 5.
bugs.why_wrong: There are five subjects, so the total must be divided by 5.

bugs.description: The B grade threshold is 70 instead of 75.
bugs.why_wrong: According to the stated grading rule, B begins at an average of 75.

title: Shopping Bill
problem_statement: Calculate a shopping bill. For each item, subtotal is price * quantity. If the subtotal is at least 1000, discount is 10%; otherwise if it is at least 500, discount is 5%; otherwise discount is 0%. Print subtotal, discount, and final amount.
input_format: First line contains N. Each of the next N lines contains price (real number) and quantity (integer).
output_format: Print Subtotal, Discount, and Final with 2 decimals on separate lines.

bugs.description: total starts at 1.0 instead of 0.0.
bugs.why_wrong: An extra 1.0 is added to every bill before item totals are processed.

bugs.description: The loop runs while i < n - 1, so the final item is skipped.
bugs.why_wrong: All N items must contribute to the subtotal.

bugs.description: The discount for totals of at least 1000 is calculated using 5% instead of 10%.
bugs.why_wrong: The stated rule gives a 10% discount at 1000 or more.

bugs.description: The discount is added to the subtotal instead of subtracted.
bugs.why_wrong: A discount reduces the amount the customer pays.

title: Attendance Eligibility
problem_statement: A student has attendance records for five subjects. For each subject, input classes held and classes attended. Compute overall attendance percentage using total attended / total held * 100. The student is Eligible if the percentage is at least 75, otherwise Not Eligible.
input_format: Input contains five pairs: classes held and classes attended.
output_format: Print total held, total attended, percentage with 2 decimals, and eligibility on separate lines.
constraints: For every subject: 1 <= held <= 100 and 0 <= attended <= held

bugs.description: totalAttended starts at 1 instead of 0.
bugs.why_wrong: An attendance count must begin at zero before adding the five subject counts.

bugs.description: The loop reads only four subject records instead of five.
bugs.why_wrong: All five subjects must be included in the overall attendance.

bugs.description: The division is performed as integer division before multiplication by 100.
bugs.why_wrong: Both totals are integers, so the ratio can become 0 or 1 before being multiplied; floating-point division is needed.

bugs.description: The program uses > 75 instead of >= 75.
bugs.why_wrong: Exactly 75% attendance is eligible according to the rule.

title: Menu-Based Number Calculator
problem_statement: Process N commands. Each command has a choice and two integers. Choice 1 prints the sum, choice 2 prints the larger number, choice 3 prints the difference a-b, and choice 4 prints the product. Any other choice prints Invalid. Print one result per command.
input_format: First line contains N. Each of the next N lines contains choice, a, b.
constraints: 1 <= N <= 20; -100 <= a,b <= 100; choice is an integer

bugs.description: The loop processes only n - 1 commands.
bugs.why_wrong: All N commands must be read and processed.

bugs.description: Choice 1 performs subtraction instead of addition.
bugs.why_wrong: Choice 1 is defined as sum, so it must calculate a + b.

bugs.description: Choice 3 performs addition instead of subtraction.
bugs.why_wrong: Choice 3 is defined as a - b.

bugs.description: Choice 4 performs addition instead of multiplication.
bugs.why_wrong: Choice 4 is defined as a * b.
